text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Whew, that wraps up my first target race 
of the year on a good note~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
choice_data_list: I could watch you without worrying at all.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you very much. So this is what 
they call smooth sailing, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Now I can go with my head held high. ...To 
the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I told you it's the Tenno Sho (Spring)!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Tama-chan. Thank you for cheering me 
on~.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Well, we're best friends, after all. But 
friendship is one thing, and races are 
another.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Heh, today made it crystal clear. 
Creek's—no, *your* weakness, that is.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That's it! As long as you don't realize 
that, you'll never be able to run any 
better than this!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: So, Tama-chan, would you mind telling me?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Well, whatever. I'll show ya next time. 
Right in front of all the fans, bam, just 
like that!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wash your neck and wait for me. Ah, ya 
don't actually gotta wash it, alright?

Tamamo Cross huffed through her nose as 
she walked away. Just what could her 
weakness be...?
